n: Galiano 48-Inch Freestanding French Door Gas Range, 8 Burners, Griddle, Convection Oven, Energy Efficient
desc: Introducing the Forno Galiano 48 Inch French Door Gas Range, designed to elevate your home kitchen with professional styling and robust performance. Crafted from durable stainless steel, this range features eight sealed burners with a total output of 107,000 BTU, including a 20,000 BTU dual-ring burner for precise simmering at 1,000 BTU.
hl: 8 Sealed Burners combine a total stove-top out of 107,000 BTU
Includes 1 Sealed Dual-Ring Burner to achieve high heat searing or delicate simmering control
Continuous Cast Iron Grates provide even heat distribution and stable cookware mobility
Convenient left swing door for easy oven cavity access.
Deep recessed black enamel range top cavity contains spills for quick clean-ups
4.32 Cu.Ft Convection Fan Oven with 30,000 BTU Total Broil and Bake output, additional 2.26 Cu.Ft. Oven with a 14,000 BTU Bake output.
